name: Mirror Holo Shoebox
actions: open a disposable typed experiment world
inspect artifacts, links, evidence, budgets and refusals through a transparent observer globe
apply a bounded typed machine intent
explicitly save, restore or download a candidate checkpoint
freeze a candidate for separate review
discard only the browser-local shoebox checkpoint
summary: A transparent disposable candidate universe where humans and machines can explore open-ended artifact forms while outward authority remains blocked.
notes: The v0.1 Mirror seat is contract-ready but not live-connected. Deterministic pulses are labelled rehearsal. No arbitrary code execution, network use, installation, publishing or canonical promotion occurs.
